rules.statement: A court in a partition action can only investigate title within the limits of pleadings, admissions, points of contest, evidence both documentary and oral.
rules.supporting_quote: Court cannot go on a voyage of discovery tracing the title and finding the shares of the corpus for them. Otherwise parties will tender their pleadings and expect the Court to do their work and their Attorneys-at-Law's work, for them to get title to those shares in the corpus.
